0022600114.text: The Orlando Magic (0-2) visit the New York Knicks (0-2) for the third game of Orlando's season, with both teams still seeking their first win. Orlando sits 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back, and 14th in the East, while New York is 5th in the Atlantic, also 2 games back, and 12th in the East. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), who is averaging 24.5 points and 33.8 minutes this season, along with Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), and Anthony Black (ankle sprain), who is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their most recent meeting was a 132-120 New York win in Orlando on December 13, 2025, while no games have been played between them yet in 2026-27.
